evidence.quote: a multi-phase study was conducted involving 12 professional developers over a three to four-week period. The evaluation incorporated real-world usage monitoring, synthetic trace modeling, and semi-structured interviews.
The forecasting service showed high predictive accuracy using 90-day developer activity traces.
The evaluation was conducted primarily with individual developers on personal projects

This paper presents an integrated Visual Studio Code extension that seamlessly monitors developer behaviors within the Integrated Development Environment and uses artificial intelligence to deliver actionable productivity insights and enhancements.
The collected metrics are transmitted to the Gemini API, an external large language model serving as the risk assessment engine.
Weekly commits increased by 32%, from 8.5 to 11.2 on average, and issue task completions rose by 24%. Defect density in code reviews decreased by 31%
The system captures a comprehensive set of developer activity metrics directly from the editor including focus duration, diagnostic density, editing cadence, commit rate and error fix time.
Error fix time improved by 35%, decreasing from an average of 7.0 minutes to 4.5 minutes.
User feedback was positive: average scores ranged from 4.2 to 4.5 out of 5 for accuracy, personalization, and clarity.
